changeSet.author: str-backend
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE str_rn.lessor DROP CONSTRAINT chk_lessor_application_status
UPDATE str_rn.lessor SET application_status = 'PENDING' WHERE application_status = 'INITIATED'
ALTER TABLE str_rn.lessor ADD CONSTRAINT chk_lessor_application_status CHECK (application_status IS NULL OR application_status IN ( 'PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED' ))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE str_rn.lessor DROP CONSTRAINT chk_lessor_application_status
UPDATE str_rn.lessor SET application_status = 'INITIATED' WHERE application_status = 'PENDING'

ALTER TABLE str_rn.lessor ADD CONSTRAINT chk_lessor_application_status CHECK (application_status IS NULL OR application_status IN ( 'INITIATED', 'IN_VERIFICATION', 'IN_PROCESSING', 'ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED' ))
